sv.title: Migranter strömmar till kanarieö – nödläge utlyst
sv.summary: En glesbefolkad liten kanarieö har tagit emot tusentals migrerande människor på kort tid, och nu har öns styre utlyst nödläge. – Situationen är helt klart ohållbar, säger regionpresident Fernando Clavijo.

en.title: Migrants flood into Canary Island – state of emergency declared
en.summary: A sparsely populated small Canary island has received thousands of migrants in a short time, and the island's government has now declared a state of emergency. – The situation is clearly unsustainable, says regional president Fernando Clavijo.
